newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real ends flat at 1.0615 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real ends flat at 1.0615 per dollar.

text.p: Brazil's real ended steady at 1.0615 reais per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market in a market still short of dollars, dealers said.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a deficit of around 40 million reais Thursday at 1630 local/1930 GMT, they added.
In the interbank foreign exchange floating rate market, the real dropped a slight 0.01 percent to end at 1.0619 reais per dollar.
In the illegal parallel market, the real closed flat at 1.100 real per greenback.
